notes:
### Added
- Toolbar reorganised to 6 buttons: Open Library, Quick Add, Add (form) |
  Scenes, Play/Stop, Light & Shadow. File import and library folder moved to
  the Extensions menu.
- Studio window, Scenes tab: list of the model's scenes; add a scene from the
  current view, view/update camera/rename/delete, seconds to the next scene,
  tick which scenes are played. Settings are stored on each scene.
- Play: smooth camera fly-through of the ticked scenes (Catmull-Rom path, no
  corners). Modes: smooth (eases only at start/end, for video) or stop at
  each scene; optional loop. When scenes store sun settings, the sun time
  moves gradually (clock and date interpolated separately).
- Studio window, Light & Shadow tab: shadows on/off, time slider, presets
  (08:00 / 12:00 / 15:00 / 17:30), date, light/dark, use sun for shading,
  save the current lighting into a scene.
